card.name: Words just before a length of time
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as for, within, over, of or only that sit right before an expected span of time (a moment, a while, two weeks, a month).

modes.label: for / within before a duration
modes.description: The word "for" or "within" comes right before a time span like a moment or two weeks.
modes.example: after gazing about him<< for>> a moment, sprang to his feet

modes.label: Other lead-ins to a time span
modes.description: Words like over, of or only that come just before a number of months, days or hours.
modes.example: It looked like no one had cleaned it in<< over>> a month.

modes.label: Verb plus it before a time span
modes.description: A pronoun after a verb such as give, before an amount of time.
modes.example: you will have to give<< it>> at least one afternoon

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with duration words such as a while, a month or a year or more, mostly in Chinese, and away from English number words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a stretch of time, like the "for" in "for a moment".
